pages.title: Do Language Models Use Their Depth Efficiently?
pages.description: Measuring how much each layer of Llama-3.1-8B actually contributes, with nnsight: per-layer residual contributions, skip-a-layer effects on later computation, and integrated gradients over depth.

pages.title: Base-10 Arithmetic Behind Cyclic Reasoning
pages.description: Llama-3.1-8B answers month and weekday arithmetic in base 10, not modular arithmetic. Fourier probes in nnsight find periods 2, 5 and 10 at layer 18 - and no period 7, even on a task built from a 7-cycle.

pages.title: The Dual-Route Model of Induction
pages.description: The dual-route model of induction in nnsight: separating token-level induction heads from concept-level ones in Llama-2-7B, and ablating each route to see what copying behaviour survives.

pages.title: Gaze Heads
pages.description: Finding the attention heads a vision-language model looks through, with nnsight: score every head in one forward pass per query, then steer what the model describes with a per-head pre-softmax attention bias.

pages.title: Progress Measures for Grokking
pages.description: Grokking reproduced end to end in nnsight: train a one-layer transformer on modular addition, find the Fourier features it learns, and watch restricted and excluded loss reveal the circuit forming long before the test loss moves.

pages.title: Demystifying Verbatim Memorization in Large Language Models
pages.description: Probing verbatim memorization in nnsight: activation patching over memorized passages in Pythia and Llama to find where a recited continuation is actually decided.

pages.title: Induction Heads and the In-Context Learning Phase Change

pages.title: Path Patching the IOI Circuit
pages.description: Path patching the indirect object identification circuit in GPT-2 with nnsight: isolating single head-to-head edges, sweeping every upstream head into a name mover's query, and separating the q, k and v pathways.

pages.title: The Jacobian Lens
pages.description: Reproducing the Jacobian lens in nnsight: reading a language model's residual stream through its causal effect on the output, steering with lens vectors, and fitting a lens from scratch on gemma-2-2b and GPT-2.

pages.title: The Geometry of Truth
pages.description: The geometry of truth in nnsight: finding the linear direction that separates true from false statements in a language model's activations, and steering along it to flip the model's verdict.

pages.title: Patchscopes
pages.description: Patchscopes in nnsight: decoding a language model's hidden states by patching them into a different prompt and letting the model explain itself. Entity description and zero-shot feature extraction on gemma-2-2b.

pages.title: Function Vectors
